questions.question: Q36
questions.text: Should public officials carry out rules without exercising personal moral judgment?
questions.finding: Kant, Thoreau and Weber directly address role and judgment. Wilson separates politics and administration rather than suspending conscience; Hegel’s universal interest is not mere blind obedience.
